scripts.a64:build: asc src/a64/index.ts -o build/a64/translator.wasm -O2 --runtime stub --enable simd --importMemory --zeroFilledMemory --memoryBase 87031808 && asc src/a64/helpers.ts -o build/a64/helpers.wasm -O2 --runtime stub --enable simd --importMemory --zeroFilledMemory --memoryBase 103809024 --enable relaxed-simd --disableWarning 112 && asc src/a64/index.ts -o build/a64/translator.shared.wasm -O2 --runtime stub --enable simd --importMemory --zeroFilledMemory --memoryBase 87031808 --sharedMemory --maximumMemory 65536 --enable threads && asc src/a64/helpers.ts -o build/a64/helpers.shared.wasm -O2 --runtime stub --enable simd --importMemory --zeroFilledMemory --memoryBase 103809024 --sharedMemory --maximumMemory 65536 --enable threads --enable relaxed-simd --disableWarning 112
scripts.a64:guests: npm run -s a64:build && npm run -s a64:guests:build && node test/a64/guests_run.ts; a=$?; echo '--- again with budget=50 (forced preemption) ---'; node test/a64/guests_run.ts --budget 50 --quiet; b=$?; echo '--- again without wasm tail calls ---'; node test/a64/guests_run.ts --notail --quiet; c=$?; exit $((a|b|c))
scripts.a64:browser: npm run -s a64:build && esbuild test/a64/browser/worker.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=build/a64/browser/worker.js --log-level=warning && node test/a64/browser/run.ts --speed
scripts.a64:big: npm run -s a64:build && python3 test/a64/guests/build.py --big && node test/a64/guests_run.ts --dir test/a64/guests/out_big --speed --mem
scripts.shaders:naga: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path tools/shaders/naga_wasm/Cargo.toml --target-dir build/shaders/naga_target && cp build/shaders/naga_target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/nx_naga.wasm build/shaders/nx_naga.wasm
